Usage:
  ghcp-cloud create [-R OWNER/REPO] [--base B] [--agent NAME] [--follow] "<task>"
  ghcp-cloud create [-R OWNER/REPO] [--base B] [--agent NAME] [--follow] -    (task on stdin)
  ghcp-cloud list [-L N]
  ghcp-cloud view <session-id | PR number | URL> [--log] [-R OWNER/REPO]
  ghcp-cloud -h | --help

  create   the task text reaches gh on stdin (`gh agent-task create -F -`), never as an
           argument; prints gh's output (the agent session / pull request URL).
           --base B       base branch of the pull request (default: the repo's default branch)
           --agent NAME   custom agent from .github/agents/NAME.md
           --follow       stream the agent session log until it finishes
  list     recent agent tasks (gh agent-task list)
  view     one task; --log shows the agent session log

Notes: `gh agent-task` is a PREVIEW feature of the GitHub CLI and may change. Every task
spends Copilot premium requests / AI credits AND GitHub Actions minutes. The repository must
be on GitHub with the Copilot coding agent enabled. Review the pull request like any other
contribution before merging.

Exit codes: 0 ok | 1 usage error | 2 gh failed | 11 gh not authenticated (run: gh auth login) |
            13 gh missing, or too old for `agent-task` | 16 GitHub unreachable (network blocked,
            e.g. by Claude Code's Bash sandbox: re-run outside it or allow api.github.com)
